 invocation produced.

maker.description:
The maker of the model of an agent run, such as Anthropic or OpenAI,
 from the list-price table: of the model role's model, or of its
 fallback's model when the fallback on another adapter ran (decisions
 0246 and 0261). Empty for an invocation that runs no model.

output.description:
The structured output, as the protojson of the message that the
 invocation document names, as the runner parsed it (decisions 0160 and
 0162).

refusals.description:
The refusals that the harness reported, from the adapter's result
 (decision 0249).

tree.description:
The tree that the runner computed from the workspace after the adapter
 exited; empty when the invocation changes no code (decisions 0160 and
 0162).

host.description: The host that the run asked to reach.

path.description:
The path, relative to the workspace or absolute, that the run asked
 to read or write.

tool.description: The kind of tool that asked.
